dataHandled.purpose: Connect directly to a server selected by the user
Display, cache, upload, and edit documents at the user's request
Show local operational failures to the user

platformIntegrations.notifications: Local only; redacted by default; no credentials, server URL, OCR, or files
platformIntegrations.osSearch: Opt-in; generic title by default; permission-filtered; no content or credentials
platformIntegrations.widgets: Locked state or bounded inbox count plus Quick Scan only
platformIntegrations.shortcuts: Fixed Quick Scan, Inbox, and Search routes only
platformIntegrations.sharing: Files selected or received by the user are staged in app-private storage
